lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Forty years in Houston heat
Hard hat on, boots worn down
Pipe-fit hands and steady faith
Built our life on solid ground
You came home tired, still smiling
With that supper table grin
Three kids watched you teach them
How a good man digs in

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the rush is finally over
And the morning`s yours to keep
Got a pole by Lake Conroe
And a lucky little seat

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
Seventy years, and still our man
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
We love you more than words can say
You worked so hard, you held us strong
(held us strong)
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
You`re the heart of this whole gang

[Verse 2]
I can still see Houston rain
On your shirt when you walked in
You`d kiss us all, ask how we were
Then go back out and do it again
You gave our kids a kind of pride
A name they wear like gold
Now they tell your stories everywhere
And our house still feels full

[Pre-Chorus]
Now the reel spins on the water
Sunrise dancing on the line
You`ve earned every quiet moment
And every little sign

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
Seventy years, and still our man
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
We love you more than words can say
You worked so hard, you held us strong
(held us strong)
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
You`re the heart of this whole gang

[Bridge]
For the long days
And the late nights
For the three kids
And the whole life
For the love you gave
And the way you stay
We thank you, Bob
More every day

[Final Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
Seventy candles, one big heart
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
Even now you light the dark
Lake Conroe mornings, Houston roads
(our hero still)
Happy birthday, Bob, happy birthday
We love you still, and always will
title: Conroe Morning Bob
